'''Vivian Kubrick''' (born August 5, 1960) is an American filmmaker and composer, best known as the daughter of the renowned director Stanley Kubrick. Over the years, Vivian has been associated with a number of conspiracy theories and controversies, attracting significant media attention.

Vivian first garnered public attention through her work on her father's films, most notably composing the score for ''Full Metal Jacket''. However, in recent years, she has become a controversial figure due to her public endorsement of various conspiracy theories. A notable instance was her outspoken criticism of the official narratives surrounding the September 11 attacks and her promotion of alternative theories, which she shared through social media and public appearances.

Her name became further entwined with controversy when she aligned herself with Infowars' Alex Jones. Vivian made several appearances on Jones's platform, where she expressed her support for his viewpoints and shared her own theories on topics such as government surveillance and media manipulation. The appearances typically focus on Vivian's life work and Alex tries to ask about her father and remote viewing which Vivian declines to discuss.
